more.def: To take in or soak up something, such as a liquid, heat, or light.
more.example: Dark clothes absorb more heat from the sun than light clothes.

easy.def: Something bad that happens that no one wanted to happen.
easy.example: I spilled my milk by accident.

more.def: Something that happens by chance and is not planned, often causing harm or damage.
more.example: He broke the vase by accident when he bumped the table.

easy.def: To do something you worked hard for.
easy.example: You can achieve your goal if you keep trying.

more.def: To succeed in doing something through effort or skill.
more.example: She achieved her dream of swimming across the lake.

easy.def: To think someone or something is very good.

more.def: To respect and look up to someone, or to enjoy looking at something.
more.example: We stopped to admire the colorful sunset.

easy.def: A fun and exciting trip or time.
easy.example: We went on an adventure in the woods.

more.def: An exciting experience, often one that is new or a little bit risky.
more.example: Sailing across the lake was the biggest adventure of her summer.

easy.example: I am afraid of the dark.

more.def: Feeling fear or worry that something bad might happen.
more.example: The puppy was afraid of the loud thunder.

easy.def: To think the same thing as someone else.
easy.example: We both agree that pizza is yummy.

more.def: To have the same opinion as someone, or to say yes to something.
more.example: Everyone agreed that the park was the best place for the picnic.

easy.example: Mom will allow me to stay up late.

more.def: To give permission for someone to do or have something.
more.example: The museum does not allow visitors to touch the paintings.

easy.example: The magic trick will amaze you.

more.def: To fill someone with great surprise or wonder.
more.example: The size of the whale amazed everyone on the boat.

easy.example: The ancient tree is older than my grandpa.

more.def: From a time very long ago, often thousands of years in the past.
more.example: We saw ancient tools in the museum that people used long ago.

easy.def: To say you do not agree, sometimes in a mad way.
easy.example: My brother and I argue about who goes first.

more.def: To disagree with someone in words, or to give reasons for what you think.
more.example: The two friends began to argue about the rules of the game.

easy.def: A person who goes into space.
easy.example: The astronaut waved from the rocket.

more.def: A person trained to travel and work in space.
more.example: The astronaut lived on the space station for six months.

easy.example: Please pay attention to the teacher.

more.def: Careful watching, listening, or thinking about something.
more.example: The loud noise caught the attention of the whole class.

easy.def: Normal, not big and not small.
easy.example: He is of average height for his age.

more.def: Usual or ordinary; in the middle, not very high or very low.
more.example: An average school day lasts about six hours.
